I need to extract the register_allocation statements from pages 24–30 of the JETP grants register. Each row is a funder allocation to a specific use, with the amount, funder, implementer, and description quoted as one contiguous text block.

From page 24, the first row (Municipalities 1. tariff design for IPPs) is:

"City of Cape Town support technical assistance to support 1. tariff design for IPPs 2. Financial modelling input to 10MW Atlantis Solar Feasibility Study 3. Energy planning support for load shedding mitigation 6. Risk and commercial review of draft final PPA" with amount $227 368 R3 876 624, funder USAID Power Africa, implementer Deloitte, phase Implementation  50% March 2021 November 2024.

The second row (Municipalities 2. Financial modelling input to 10MW Atlantis Solar Feasibility Study) is:

"Capacity Collective planning / training 8,5bn" with amount $9 219 R157 184, funder USAID Power Africa 2023, implementer Deloitte, phase Implementation 50% February 2024.

The third row (Municipalities 3. High level pre-feasibility of a 60MWac Solar PV Facility at the Paardevlei site, Somerset-West) is:

"Revenue Management / training 8,5bn 1. SAEP and DBSA collaboration, 2. SALGA - knowledge product for revenue management" with amount $210 699 R3 592 418, funder USAID Power Africa 2022, implementer Deloitte, phase Implementation 50% October 2023.

The fourth row (Municipalities 4. Energy project transaction support to catalyse investment) is:

"Skills hub for JET / training 8,5bn Establishing a Women's JET Champions Learning Network" with amount $449 743 R7 668 118, funder USAID Power Africa 2022, implementer Deloitte, phase Implementation 50% 01 March 2022 30 April 2024.

The fifth row (Municipalities 5. Energy planning support for load shedding mitigation) is:

"Skills / training 8,5bn TVET support: JET technical training to women in electrical /RE field Phases 1 and 2" with amount $1 617 041 R27 570 549, funder USAID Power Africa 2022, implementer Deloitte, phase Implementation 50% 01 March 2022 30 April 2024.

From page 25, the sixth row (Municipalities 6. Risk and commercial review of draft final PPA) is:

"Technical Assistance 8,5bn 1. SANEDI VRE Modelling Capacity Building Activity 2. Industry knowledge building: VRE integration 3. VRE Integration Workshops/Webinars 4. Scoping study for healthcare facility electrification using RE 8. Health Facility Support Services Electrification: ANOVA Support" with amount $286 850 R4 890 793, funder USAID Power Africa 2023, implementer Deloitte, phase Implementation 50% March 2024.

From page 26, the seventh row (Electricity Distribution infrastructure) is:

"The Department of State, Bureau of Energy Resources' Power Sector Program (ENR/PSP) - electricity regulatory partnership with NERSA implemented by the National Association of Regulatory Utility Commissioners (NARUC). Activities focus on distribution system interconnection fees and standards and on auditing and prudence review of utility investments. In addition, ENR/PSP is providing new assistance to increase investment in RE generation and to facilitate direct PPAs with RE IPPs As part of this support, ENR/PSP are engaging SALGA and member municipalities to provide support on facilitating wheeling of power between consumers and IPPs, including the development of wheeling charges." with amount $550 000 R9 377 500, funder Department of State, implementer Deloitte and NARUC, phase Implementation 75% January 2022 December 2024.

The eighth row (Community Mobilise PSET funding for JET organisational development) is:

"The Women-Led Coal Transition Mechanism (WOLCOT) aims to enhance women’s climate leadership and effective participation in the design and decision-making of coal-to-clean transition strategies and implementation." with amount $2 310 000 R39 385 500, funder Canada / Global Affairs, implementer ACT-IP, phase Implemented 75% 2021.

The ninth row (Community JT-Mpumalanga organisational development) is:

"ESKOM" with amount $47 690 000 R813 114 500, funder Canada / Global Affairs 2023, implementer ACT-IP, phase Pledged 0% December 2027.

From page 27, the tenth row (Electricity Transmission infrastructure) is:

"Capacity building within ESKOM, DMRE, NERSA and IPPO is a key part of supporting transition towards RE, eventually benefitting Esk om, DMRE, IPPO the South African society in increasing generation, transmission and distribution capacity and energy security." with amount $2 492 875 R42 503 519, funder Danish Energy Agency, implementer Danish MFA, phase Implementation 75% November 2021 December 2025.

 The eleventh row (Electricity Distribution infrastructure) is:

"Capacity building within ESKOM, DMRE, NERSA and IPPO is a key part of supporting transition towards RE, eventually benefitting Esk om, DMRE, IPPO the South African society in increasing generation, transmission and distribution capacity and energy security." with amount $3 046 863 R51 949 006, funder Danish Energy Agency, implementer Danish MFA, phase Implementation 50% November 2021 December 2025.

The twelfth row (Improving infrastructure for Mpumalanga development) is:

"Mining Rights Mapping and Planning in Mpumalanga To be overlaid with other information available to support the rolling out of large-scale RE in Mpumalanga province" with amount $149 463 R2 548 336, funder Danish MFA, implementer Green Cape, phase Implementation 75% January 2022 December 2024.

The thirteenth row (Improving infrastructure for Mpumalanga development) is:

"Residents of three selected municipalities in Mpumalanga, including a common understanding of the required framework conditions for local municipalities in the province to explore alternative service delivery models" with amount $366 163 R6 243 071, funder Danish MFA, implementer Green Cape, phase Implementation 50% January 2022 December 2024.

The fourteenth row (Improving infrastructure for Mpumalanga development) is:

"This project aims to improve digital infrastructure for RE, by mapping out where the most suitable sites for on-shore wind energy is located in South Africa, with a special focus on detailed mapping of winds in Mpumalanga, as it is a high priority area for just and green transitioning. The maps will be made for public use." with amount $2 062 500 R35 165 625, funder Danish Energy Agency, implementer Zanedi, phase Implementation 25% January 2023 December 2025.

The fifteenth row (Electricity JT sector) is:

"Projects involve supporting and developing small local businesses and upskilling and education local workforces, and promoting local engagement." with amount $2 895 338 R49 365 504, funder Danish MFA, implementer NUM 3F, phase Implementation 50% January 2022 December 2026.

From page 28, the sixteenth row (Skills Mobilise PSET funding for JET) is:

"On average 3 scholars in Denmark annually on topics related to green transition and climate change" with amount $1 925 000 R 32 821 250, funder DANIDA, implementer Denmark, phase Implementation 50% N/A Running basis.

The seventeenth row (Skills Mobilise PSET funding for JET) is:

"On average 100 scholars on short courses at an annual basis on topics related to green transition and climate change" with amount $1 925 000 R32 821 250, funder DANIDA, implementer Denmark, phase Implementation 50% N/A Running basis.

The eighteenth row (Skills Mobilise PSET funding for JET) is:

"Research collaboration on water and Energy between South Africa and Denmark. 5 research collaborations ongoing, and 5 research collaborations in pipeline." with amount $5 775 000 R98 463 750, funder DANIDA, implementer Denmark, phase Implementation 50% N/A Running basis.

The nineteenth row (Skills Food and Agriculture partnership) is:

"Multiple activities to support the decommissioning of the Grootvlei power station by facilitating the development of alternative livelihoods in the area." with amount $2 160 000 R36 828 000, funder Netherlands, implementer Eskom, phase Implementation 25% January 2022 December 2025.

The twentieth row (Community JT-Mpumal ng youth development) is:

"Youth-driven project to support participation of youth in climate debates and decision-making." with amount $186 581 R3 181 199, funder Netherlands, implementer Institute for International Affairs, phase Implementation 25% October 2025.

The twenty-first row (Municipalities on water management) is:

"Aims to provide 2 million people with access to sufficient, safe and reliable water by 2030. Works at 5 different project, including one in Mbombela, Mpumalanga. Total budget is 8 million euros." with amount $1 867 752 R31 845 172, funder Netherlands, implementer DWS, phase Implementation 25% January 2023 December 2030.

The twenty-second row (Green SA-H2 Fund) is:

"SA-H2 is an innovative blended finance fund, that will facilitate and accelerate the development of a green hydrogen sector and circular economy in South Africa." with amount $54 000 000 R920 700 000, funder Netherlands, implementer TBD, phase B. Pledged 0%.

The twenty-third row (Green hydrogen) is:

"Multiple activities to support skills development and feasibility studies to accelerate the green hydrogen economy." with amount $2 160 000 R36 828 000, funder Netherlands, implementer partners, phase Implementation 25% January 2022 December 2025.

From page 29, the twenty-fourth row (Skills Mobilise PSET funding for JET) is:

"This project will analyse clean energy value chains and their relationships with the rest of the economy. This approach provides an interdisciplinary framework for unpacking the complex issues in the clean energy value chain. It will trace consumption and production to the practices, history and relations that are reproduced within the clean energy value chains by analysing them at different levels, including agents and agencies, structures, processes, relations and the cultural and contextual factors." with amount $608 300 R10 371 515, funder Canada, implementer IDRC, phase Implementation 25% November 2021 November 2024.

The twenty-fifth row (Skills Mobilise PSET funding for JET) is:

 "This project will address these knowledge gaps by developing a practical framework that can inform future developments and the implementation of just transition pathways. It will assess the effectiveness of different renewable energy technologies in accelerating green jobs creation and a low-carbon trajectory in Uganda and South Africa; analyse the equity and distribution implications of energy transition in vulnerable communities across gender, age, and income groups; develop potential financial and business models to deliver a just transition pathway; and explore appropriate policy and regulatory interventions. The project will generate recommendations for future research and targeted policy interventions." with amount $192 500 R3 282 125, funder Canada, implementer IDRC 2021, phase Implementation 25% November 2021 November 2024.

From page 30, the twenty-sixth row (Skills Mobilise PSET funding for JET) is:

"This project will contribute to addressing three key areas of importance for energy transition (in India, Indonesia, and South Africa) where knowledge gaps are holding back inclusive change, particularly for women and youth, but also marginalized groups. The specific themes have been selected based on experience from IISD’s country programmes on the current state of the debate; the opportunity for transformative change from the application of these elements of transition; and our belief that the impacts of policies on women, youth and marginalized groups has not been sufficiently understood or given adequate consideration in policymaking." with amount $308 000 R5 251 400, funder Canada, implementer IDRC, phase Implementation 25% January 2023 June 2026.

The twenty-seventh row (Skills Mobil ize PSET funding for JET) is:

"This project will conduct an in-depth analysis of the pathways to achieving transitions towards sustainable, low-carbon and equitable energy systems, including an assessment of capacity needs and skills. It will identify and analyse innovative options for financing in line with emerging energy goals. These include providing at least USD 300 million to Africa’s access to clean energy, launched at COP 27, and increasing the continent’s renewable energy capacity to 25% of global renewable energy investments." with amount $161 700 R2 756 985, funder Canada, implementer NPC, phase Implementation 25% March 2023 30 June 2026.
